scope: Late per-slot rota candidate read/retry presentation, popup identity, local manual input/focus preservation and route/listener lifecycle.
changes: Refresh content within the existing popup root; retain local person selection when present in refreshed options, override reason, replace checkbox, owned focus/text selection and body scroll.

When selected member disappears, clear selection and announce review requirement. An empty refreshed list retains manual text/checkbox controls with an empty member list and unavailable explanation; no old candidate option is reintroduced.

Failed candidate reads retain inputs and offer explicit Retry candidate suggestions. Retry focus goes to a replacement retry or current view switch only when focus fell to body; newer focus is preserved.
Ignore successful/error results if the template/account/month context changed. Per-request tokens prevent an old request cleanup clearing a newer slot loading marker.
Close day popup during accepted route navigation, matching previous nested-overlay unmount behavior. Scope new outside-shell action bridge to the existing view event AbortSignal.

checks.requests: GET-only intercepted candidate reads plus GET-only disposable companion API; no assignment/apply/publish writes.
checks.static_inventories: Style/action source inventories refreshed and match; not runtime certification.

limitations: Root implementer verification; no fresh independent signoff.
Tests cover declared late-response scenarios. Account/template object guard and overlapping token cleanup are source safeguards, not newly exercised multi-account/security race certification.
The compact late-response test proves current mode/focus retention. Manual draft persistence across an intentional Full-to-Compact-to-Full switch remains a separate acceptance gap.
Missing candidate clears local selection; server remains eligibility authority. No scheduling, scoring, API shape, persistence or export content changes.
New recovery scenarios use default light theme; current day regression includes dark320/light1280. No full theme/role/slot-action matrix, native AT or physical-device certification.
Mixed per-slot partial success retains existing Promise.all behavior and needs separate audit; no retry replay or partial-batch semantics introduced.
Only frontend main.ts changed in this batch; concurrent backend work preserved. Full260 and same-fixture equivalence remain open.
